scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:worker: PYTHONPATH=services/api uv run --extra advanced python -m baseera.worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @baseera/web && uv run ruff check services tests
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace @baseera/web && uv run ruff format --check services tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @baseera/web && uv run mypy services/api/baseera
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @baseera/web && uv run pytest
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @baseera/web && uv run pytest --cov=services/api/baseera --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=80
